You were born into a clan of doomsday preppers in the Main
Belt, mining asteroids and comets. When the Fall came, you
couldn’t hide away while your species went extinct. So you
left your family behind, egocast to Mars, and volunteered to
help refugees. You put yourself through school at CalTechMars with corporate sponsorships, majoring in archeology
and engineering, then freelanced for various hypercorps
exploring through the Martian Gate. Your broad scientifi c
background makes you an invaluable asset whether
you are erecting a new colony, surveying alien ruins, or
troubleshooting a mission’s gear. You’re also a decent pilot.
Your handle is the name of a naga sage from Hindu myth
